title: Epicurious Recipes Scraper
description: Collect recipes from Epicurious collections, ingredient pages, or individual recipe URLs. Returns ingredients, instructions, times, servings, ratings, nutrition, and source metadata.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Epicurious collection, ingredient, or recipe URL where scraping begins.

recipeType.title: Recipe Label
recipeType.description: Optional label stored as recipe_type, such as vegetarian or dessert.

collectDetails.title: Collect Full Recipe Details
collectDetails.description: Visit each recipe page for ingredients and instructions. Disable to collect titles, descriptions, and URLs only.

results_wanted.title: Maximum Number of Recipes
results_wanted.description: Stop after saving this many recipes.

max_pages.title: Maximum Pages to Visit
max_pages.description: Pagination limit for collection and ingredient pages.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for requests. Residential proxies are recommended for larger result sets.
